description: BuildOps unifies the chaos of commercial contracting, replacing disconnected tools and manual workflows with one purpose-built AI-powered platform.
Encord is the leading data development platform for computer vision and multimodal AI teams.
Skydio leads in autonomous flight, pushing the edge of what’s possible with AI-powered drones built for mission-critical use.
Tractian uses AI to predict equipment failures and eliminate unplanned downtime, transforming maintenance from reactive to strategic advantage for industrial operations.
VAST is building the AI Operating System, a global data platform where intelligent agents store, think, communicate, and act autonomously.
Verkada helps organizations run safer, smarter buildings through a single cloud-based physical security platform with AI-powered insights that turn data into actionable intelligence.
15Five is a leading continuous performance management platform that guides employee growth and development and empowers everyone to become their best selves at work.
Aeva develops next-generation sensing and perception systems for autonomous vehicles and more using FMCW LiDAR technology.

Aforza helps consumer goods companies sell more and grow faster through Vertical AI, Cloud and Mobile solutions. Aforza connects trade planning and field sales teams to solve for unprofitable promotions, declining market share, and lack of revenue growth, enabling CPG companies to transform their product distribution and customer engagement processes on every channel.

Alaiko is Europe’s leading fulfillment-as-a-service platform that enables online shops to scale their operations without friction. Rapidly growing e-commerce brands and their customers benefit from state-of-the-art warehousing, operational excellence, and automated process control.
Antenna collects data across the stack to help developers and teams ship software faster with better visibility and automation.
Apollo GraphQL is the leader in graph-based API orchestration. Apollo helps engineering teams build unified graphs to accelerate application development and deliver better, more cohesive experiences.

Armorblox secures enterprise communications over email and other cloud office applications through the power of Natural Language Understanding. Protecting over 9,000 organizations, the Armorblox platform connects over APIs and analyzes thousands of signals to understand the context of communications and protect people and data from compromise.
Aurasell’s AI-driven Intelligence and Automation platform empowers GTM teams to maximize productivity through Human-to-Human interaction across the customer lifecycle.
Avidbots designs, manufactures, and supports fully autonomous, multi-application cleaning robots for commercial spaces. The company brings robots to everyday life to expand human potential.

Bizzabo empowers every organizer, marketer, exhibitor, and attendee to unleash the power of professional events. The company’s Event Experience Operating System (EEOS) powers immersive in-person, virtual, and hybrid events. It also enables companies to measure, manage, and scale events towards key business outcomes.

Blink creates trust and dialogue between frontline workers in real-time through a simple mobile app, giving them one-click access to everything they need to thrive—from updates to must-knows, content to collaborations, conversations to stories.

Bringg is the leading delivery logistics platform, providing enterprises with the most efficient way to manage their complex delivery operations. Some of the world’s best-known brands in more than 50 countries gain clear strategic value from Bringg’s powerful SaaS platform.
Built Robotics‘ mission is to build the robots that build the world.
cargo.one is the leading platform for booking and managing air freight capacity, transforming how airlines and freight forwarders operate and deliver value to their customers.
Claroty empowers industrial, healthcare, public sector, and commercial organizations to secure all cyber-physical systems in their environments: the Extended Internet of Things (XioT).

Cohesity is the leader in AI-powered data security. The company brings smartphone-like simplicity to secondary data and apps, with one software-defined, hyperconverged solution for backups, files, objects, test/dev, and analytics.

DataGrail is the data privacy platform for modern brands to build customer trust and transparency. The company’s complete, enterprise-grade data privacy platform is powered by patented Risk Intelligence technology that detects shadow IT and makes vulnerable data visible so brands can proactively manage risk.

DeepScale develops AI perception software for advanced driver assistance and autonomous driving with a focus on implementing efficient neural networks on automotive-grade processors. DeepScale’s neural nets use data from various sensors to help vehicles of all automated driving levels better understand the world around them.
Echo is on a mission to make cloud-native infrastructure secure by design. They deliver true zero-CVE images with unparalleled compatibility, powered by a proprietary, AI-driven factory.

Enzo Health is an AI-driven platform built specifically for home health. Connecting front office, clinical, and back office operations in one system, Enzo automates each stage of the patient journey from referral to revenue, helping agencies take on more patients, protect their reimbursement, and give their clinicians time to focus on care.

Euno is the enterprise AI context platform, built for how AI agents work. By ensuring every agent receives precisely the context it needs, and nothing more, Euno enables enterprises to confidently run autonomous agents in production, while maintaining full control of trust, governance, and economics.

Freehand, formerly Pando, is an agentic AI platform for supply chain and spend management. Its autonomous AI Teams replace manual operations across procurement, supplier management and finance ops for complex categories like Logistics, Direct Materials and MRO — reading unstructured data, reasoning across contracts and policies, and executing decisions directly in enterprise systems.

Gecko protects and maintains civilization’s most critical infrastructure through advanced robotics and software platforms. Inspections with Gecko are faster, safer, and provide plants and facilities with unprecedented data detail that enables them to be proactive about the health of their assets.

Halcyon is the only cybersecurity company that eliminates the business impact of ransomware. Modern enterprises rely on Halcyon to prevent ransomware attacks, eradicating cybercriminals’ ability to encrypt systems, steal data, and extort companies.

With Harmonic Security, organizations can finally move beyond the limitations of traditional data protection methods. Instead of relying on rigid rules and legacy DLP, Harmonic uses modern language models to understand the context of data in real-time.

Kai is the AI company rebuilding cybersecurity for the machine-speed era. Trusted by Fortune 500 enterprises, Kai is building a future where security has no categories, no silos, and no human-speed bottlenecks. The Kai Agentic AI Platform replaces fragmented, human-limited workflows with agentic AI systems that continuously contextualize, assess, reason, and execute security work at machine speed. ‍

Locus Robotics helps retailers, 3PLs, and specialty warehouses efficiently meet and exceed the increasingly complex and demanding requirements of fulfillment environments through their powerful and intelligent autonomous mobile robots that operate collaboratively with human workers. Easily integrating into large-scale new and existing warehouse infrastructures without disrupting workflows, Locus transforms productivity without transforming the warehouse.

Logz.io helps cloud-native businesses monitor and secure their environment. The company’s Open 360™ Platform turns observability from a high-cost, low-value burden into a high-value, cost-efficient enabler of better business outcomes by combining and extending familiar, powerful, and relevant open source capabilities across Logs, Metrics, and Traces—complemented by security monitoring in the form of cloud-based SIEM.

Luminary is a Physics AI platform for rapid design iteration, design exploration, and optimization. Customers span industries from automotive and aerospace, to leading sporting equipment providers, including Otto Aviation, Joby Aviation, Piper Aircraft and Trek Bikes.‍

Markforged has developed the world’s largest fleet of cloud-based industrial 3D printers, powering thousands of top manufacturers and brands across the globe. The company’s The Digital Forge platform enables engineers and designers to go from design to fully functional industrial parts at the point-of-need.

Metadata is a B2B marketing operating system that orchestrates paid acquisition across channels and website personalization. Demand gen teams from Zoom, Okta, Juniper Networks, and Thoughtspot rely on Metadata to track marketing ROI, build custom audiences based on firmographic and intent data, and conduct multivariate testing to optimize campaign performance.

Nominal is redefining how finance teams operate with the first agentic AI built specifically for accounting and financial operations. Designed for controllers and CFOs, Nominal bridges the ERP gap by automating the close, reconciliation, consolidations, intercompany transactions, and reporting workflows with human-level decision-making capabilities.

Noname Security creates the most powerful, complete, and easy-to-use API security platform that helps enterprises discover, analyze, remediate, and test all legacy and modern APIs by detecting attacks, suspicious behavior, and misconfigurations using AI-based behavioral analysis.

Observe.AI is the leading AI platform for contact centers, helping brands analyze 100% of calls and streamline quality assurance workflows. The company uses automatic speech recognition and Natural Language Processing to transform customer experiences and improve agent performance.

Patlytics is an AI-powered platform that supports the full patent lifecycle, helping law firms, in-house teams, and IP professionals navigate the complexities of patent prosecution, litigation, licensing, management, and more — from invention disclosure to infringement detection, drafting to invalidity analysis, and beyond. Trusted by top-tier firms, including those from the Am Law 100 and ranked in the top tiers for patent litigation and prosecution by Chambers, IAM Patent 1000, and Legal 500, as well as Fortune 500 companies, Patlytics empowers IP professionals to focus on strategic patent innovation by helping to reduce cycle times, increase margins, and deliver winning IP outcomes.

Radiant Security offers an AI-powered security co-pilot for Security Operations Centers (SOCs). Radiant enables SOCs to harness the power of AI to boost analyst productivity, detect more real attacks, and slash incident response times from days or weeks to minutes. Deployed in minutes via API, Radiant Security provides rapid time to value and immediately reduces analyst workloads by as much as 95%.

rideOS designs and builds next generation routing, mapping, and marketplace services that can be utilized by delivery and logistics companies, ride-hailing providers, and automotive OEMs to operate on-demand transportation services for both human-operated and self-driving fleets.

Scoutbee enables fast end-to-end strategic sourcing processes by bringing together comprehensive and dynamic supplier data with AI, deep insights, and a simple, digital process. The company helps strengthen supply chain resilience, improve sustainability, drive innovation, and reduce time to market.
Sennder brings precision and transparency to Europe’s freight industry, connecting shippers and carriers through a digital backbone built for scale.
Sila is a next-generation battery materials company with the mission to power the world’s transition to clean energy.

Skylo is a leading NTN provider with its innovative approach to direct-to-device connectivity, which allows standard cellular devices to connect to existing satellites, eliminating the need for specialized hardware or modems typically associated with legacy satellite solutions.
Sona is the AI platform for frontline enterprises, helping large organizations run more efficient operations at scale while delivering better service.

Sysdig is driving the secure DevOps movement, empowering organizations to confidently secure containers, Kubernetes, and cloud. With Sysdig, teams secure the build, detect and respond to threats, continuously validate cloud posture and compliance, and monitor performance at enterprise scale.
TigerEye’s business simulation engine helps make better strategic decisions, faster. The company’s powerfully simple tools guide strategic planning, operations, and execution.

Turvo, the world’s first real-time Internet of Things (IoT) logistics platform, is revolutionizing logistics with a ground-breaking IoT software platform that creates the “Internet of Shipping”—connecting people, businesses, applications, and devices in one AI-driven platform.

Two Dots provides income and identity verification solutions to large managers, while preventing fraud and automating work. Two Dots helps multifamily managers save millions in prevented leasing fraud while fostering operational excellence through automation and AI.

Varjo makes the highest-immersion virtual and mixed reality products for advanced VR users. The company’s solutions are used to train astronauts, pilots, and nuclear power plant operators, design cars, and conduct pioneering research.

Vitally is the first Customer Success Platform (CSP) specifically designed for maximizing productivity, visibility, and collaboration. Vitally is the only workspace that combines productivity and collaboration tools with essential customer data, empowering B2B Customer Success teams to increase net retention revenue (NRR), deliver the best possible customer experience, and increase their team’s efficiency.

Wandelbots enables anyone, regardless of prior knowledge, to learn and relearn industrial robots using an intuitive app and intelligent teaching devices. Wandelbots makes the use of robots easier, more flexible, and cost-effective.

XBuild is the first true AI platform built for construction, helping contractors streamline their estimating process and win more jobs. The platform generates professional proposals that save contractors hours of manual work while improving accuracy. ‍

Yellowbrick Data empowers companies to make faster decisions with all of their data. Built for enterprises and the hybrid cloud, the Yellowbrick Data Warehouse deploys powerful analytics anywhere, with best-in-class economics.

Zesty offers the world’s first AI-driven cloud management technology that auto-scales cloud resources to fit real-time application needs via automation. Zesty’s technology increases cloud efficiency, improves DevOps productivity, and reduces cloud costs with zero human input.
